items.title: Procter And Gamble (PG) Pushes Scalp Care While Valuation Debate Stays In Focus
items.summary: Procter & Gamble (PG) just pushed its Head & Shoulders brand further into science-led scalp care, rolling out the new HydraZinc Complex across multiple dandruff shampoo lines at a suggested US$6.99 price point. For investors watching Procter & Gamble’s share price, the story has been more muted than the product news. The stock closed at US$145.68 and has slipped over the past week.
